_comment: LEVEL 4 (component): one cohesive module, bigger than a snippet, smaller than a feature. Import the helpers, wire once.
name: comp-csv-exporter
description: CSV exporter: stream any list-of-dicts to a file or string, encoding-safe, quoted fields. Import: from {{ utils_dir }}.csv_export import export_csv
notes: Usage: export_csv(rows, 'report.csv') or csv_text = to_csv_string(rows). Column order = first row's keys; missing keys become empty cells. UTF-8 with BOM so Excel opens it correctly.
